title: Full Body Routine
author: 18Wheeler
desc:
2 training day that target full body and let you slot in circuit training for cutting. It can be cardio or abs or arms day. depends on your priority.
Day 1 will be heavy days focus on the strength. Try not to train to beyond failure and keep one reps in the tank.
Day 2 will focus on the hypertrophy/ bodybuilding style of training with higher volume. choose dumbbell or machine based exercise and goes all out to failure bodybuilding style leave no reps in tank.
Feel free to modify the exercise movement with the movement you like.

ex.note: Minimum reps goal is 10 reps. Try to work up 15-20 reps before you add on new weight.

ss.note: Try to train the easier variations of pull up. Scapula pull up/ negative pull up/ assistant pull up
Train push up first if you cannot do dips.
Choose smith machine for more stability. Do it incline style if you have shoulder issue.
Do a few cheat curl and once you can't get the bar up.
Use supinated grip if you have weak grip.
Use the same weight that you can do for 10 reps of.

ex.note: Substitute with good morning or RDL or even Nordic curls if your hams is strong enough.
Slowly work up to a single top set.

ss.note: You can choose Pinwheel Curls or Cable Hammer Curls.
10 reps skull crusher + 10 reps close grips bench press.

ex.note: Minimum reps goal is 10 reps. Try to work up 15-20 reps before you add on new weight.
Use the same weight that you can do 10 reps of.
Choose smith machine for max stability. Switch to dumbell or barbell if the smith is unavailable.

ss.note: High reps band pushdown if the cable machine is unavailable.
Sissy Squats/ Walking Lunges
